package: DFN-6 2.44 x 2.44 mm with die pad

footprint_drawing.exposed_pad: 1.25 x 1.7 land (stencil 1.05 x 1.5), 0.3 x 45 deg chamfer at pin 1
footprint_drawing.pin_order: 1,2,3 down the left side, 4,5,6 up the right side (transparent top view, p7)
footprint_drawing.opening: 0.8 mm dia on top, offset towards the bottom-right corner

circuit.value: Rp e.g. 10k in ds; 2.2k on this bus

supplies.note: measurement 4.3 mA and conditioning 6.5 mA typ are given at 1.8 V; the 3.3 V figures (about 3.0 and 4.2 mA) are the second rows of the same table, whose numbers the text extraction dropped

logic: I2C levels follow VDD (1.7-3.6 V); 3.3 V bus direct (p12)
placement: Shared gas vent; opening on top. Keep out of bright light (p8, 2.6).
Away from heat and from the MiCS-5524 heater and other outgassing parts (adhesives, fresh plastics).
No board wash or ultrasonic cleaning; fit in the last reflow pass (p19).
notes: Idle is 34 uA typ / 105 uA max: put it on the switched gas rail to reach a few uA asleep.
Sequence: 10 s conditioning command once after power-up, then measure every 1 s; turn_heater_off returns to idle (p9).
VOC/NOx index needs Sensirion's gas index algorithm (C source, BSD) fed with SHT40 RH/T: these arrive via the STCC4.

Superseded in REPORT.md: keep the SGP41 on the always-on +3V3_SENS rail (34 uA idle) unless it sits behind an enable-able I2C buffer; an unpowered part may clamp I2C_S. GAS_HTR_EN now switches only the MiCS-5524 heater.
unverified: Exact 3.3 V supply-current numbers (see supplies.note): confirm on the datasheet page before budgeting to the mA.
